sql.label: The article
sql.statement: SELECT lang, page_id, rev_id, wikidata_id, title, date_modified FROM article WHERE lang = ? AND page_id = ?

sql.label: Has history
sql.statement: SELECT rev_id, user, row_start AS saved_at FROM article_history WHERE page_id = ?

sql.label: Edits and reverts per month
sql.statement: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(row_start, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS edits, SUM(is_revert) AS reverts, SUM(is_revert AND undid_anonymous) AS reverts_of_anonymous FROM ( SELECT row_start, COALESCE((sha1 <> LAG(sha1) OVER (ORDER BY row_start) AND MIN(row_start) OVER (PARTITION BY sha1) < row_start), 0) AS is_revert, COALESCE(LAG(anonymous) OVER (ORDER BY row_start), 0) AS undid_anonymous FROM article_history FOR SYSTEM_TIME ALL WHERE page_id = ? ) AS versions GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

sql.label: First and last version
sql.statement: SELECT MIN(row_start) AS first_version, MAX(row_start) AS last_version FROM article_history FOR SYSTEM_TIME ALL WHERE page_id = ?
